name: Streaming The Backbone Pattern A Graph Substrate Architecture For Governing Multi Agent Ai A5De3023C1
text: The Backbone Pattern specifies a graph substrate as a bounded coordination layer for topology, mandates, and traceability rather than as the repository for all agentic state. This extends Kaal's infrastructure-neutral settlement-substrate claim with a concrete separation-of-concerns design. The abstract does not test stake-weighted validation or Kaal's full computative-agent primitive.
